- current model sizes and KV cache expectations

- deployment topology options (shared vs dedicated pools)
- security/compliance touchpoints your infra team needs to see

- Wed 11/11, 14:00–15:30 PT

1) 5–10m — introductions + goals for the session (Jasmine / Alex)
2) 15–25m — production profile walkthrough (StormBridge: traffic, p99 targets, model sizes)
3) 20–30m — runtime & deployment options (Redwood: caching, quantization, batch/latency tradeoffs)
4) 10–15m — failure modes & multi‑region failover (include discussion of graceful degradation)
5) 10–15m — ops runbook / handoff items and next steps
